shared_elements: schematic human figures shown frontally/in profile
seated or standing figures with raised arms
boats/watercraft (A) vs. registers of scene panels (B) — only loosely
justification: Both surfaces show schematic human figures engaged with handheld objects, and both include small repeated signs, which is about as generic as figural imagery gets. A is an unregistered scatter of stick-limbed figures with sun-discs and multi-crewed boats across an open rock face, while B is a rigidly ruled composition of horizontal registers of seated/standing figures with offering tables plus a band of script and a winged/eye emblem at the top — different organising principles and different specific motifs.
